summary: Frontend testing of local notifications feature (Capacitor LocalNotifications + Web Notification API). Verified NotificationsToggle card on desktop /profile and mobile /profile, granted/denied/default permission states, click-to-enable flow with localStorage persistence, boot-time syncReminders populating pc_scheduled_notifs from /api/reminders, and that the web Notification constructor is actually invoked via setTimeout at next_due timestamp. Backend smoke check confirms /api/profile, /api/plants, /api/reminders still return 200 (no regression). No JS errors related to @capacitor/local-notifications on the web bundle — lazy import works as expected.
test_report_links: /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (unchanged from iter 5; backend untouched, only smoke-checked via fetch from page)
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.js: showWebNotification re-uses tag `pc-rem-<id>` (good, dedupes). However scheduleWeb only arms reminders due within 24h — long-horizon reminders rely on the AppRoutes boot useEffect to re-arm on next app load. This is intentional and documented in code comment.

notifications.js getPermissionState returns 'prompt' from Capacitor but Notification API returns 'default' — NotificationsToggle correctly handles both as falsy for granted/denied/unsupported, so the enable button shows. Consistent UX.
App.js boot useEffect: catches API error and falls back to remindersCache.getAll() for offline sync — correct offline-first behavior.

syncQueue.js flushQueue: re-runs syncReminders after flush — guarantees notifications stay in sync with any reminders auto-created by backend after queued ops are flushed (e.g., propagation reminders). Good design.
Minor: webTimers Map is module-scoped, so reloads lose timers. Boot useEffect handles re-arming. No action needed.

Minor (test infra, not code bug): RemindersPage uses `toggle-reminder-<index>` (positional) rather than `toggle-reminder-<id>`. Both work functionally but id-based testids would be more robust for automated regression testing of individual reminders. Optional enhancement.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_Plant + 3s-future water reminder during browser test to verify web Notification fires at next_due via setTimeout. All test data deleted on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Headless Chromium IGNORES context.grant_permissions(['notifications']) and Browser.setPermission CDP call for the Notification API — Notification.permission always reads 'denied'. To test granted state you MUST override window.Notification via context.add_init_script BEFORE page.goto. See iteration_6 test script. The NotificationsToggle component, lib/notifications.js (web path), and boot syncReminders all work correctly. Capacitor lazy import is verified: no @capacitor/local-notifications errors on web. Native Capacitor path could not be exercised in browser, but Capacitor.isNativePlatform()===false correctly bypasses it.
verified_flows: ✅ Desktop /profile: NotificationsToggle card renders with title 'Notifiche', description, BellOff icon, and either Attiva button or status pill
✅ Permission=granted (mocked): data-testid=notif-status-granted visible, enable button hidden
✅ Permission=denied: data-testid=notif-status-denied visible with correct Italian text
✅ Permission=default + click Attiva: requestPermission → granted → localStorage['pc_notif_permission']='granted' → UI flips to granted pill, toast.success fires
✅ Boot useEffect: AppRoutes fetches /api/reminders and calls syncReminders → localStorage['pc_scheduled_notifs'] populated with enabled reminder IDs

✅ Web Notification constructor invoked via setTimeout exactly when reminder is due (verified by spying window.Notification — fired with correct title '💧 Annaffia', body 'TEST_Plant — test', tag 'pc-rem-<id>')
✅ No console errors related to @capacitor/local-notifications on web (lazy import keeps bundle clean)

⚠️ Reminder toggle off/on → pc_scheduled_notifs update: COULD NOT EXECUTE due to incorrect testid in test (toggle uses index, not id). Code path looks correct in RemindersPage (calls syncReminders/cancelReminder). Main agent can self-verify by toggling a reminder on /reminders and inspecting localStorage.
